text: How to react to a lack of initiative from a girl You text her first every time, she responds, maybe even fast, and she's nice, but she never initiates. What does it mean? Here's the deal, if you haven't slept with her yet, that's completely normal. Some girls just don't text first before there's intimacy. No big deal, that's part of the game. But what about after sex? If you have spent a couple of nights together, but you are not in a relationship, and there is still lack of initiative from her, it still can be okay. Do not overthink it, enjoy it once it lasts. Text when you want, see each other when you both can, but understand that there's probably no future. So do not overinvest your time and emotions into it. What about being in a relationship? If you're in a relationship, and she still never texts first, never says I miss you, never asks to meet, that is not normal. It means she's not really invested in you. She might enjoy your company, but she's not putting in effort. And if she doesn't care enough to put in effort, why are you even in that relationship? Do not waste your time on a person who doesn't match your energy and doesn't want to give you real connection. Better find a person who will.
